questions.subject: ALGEBRA_I

options.text: Both quantities are outputs because the planner reports both of them
options.misconception: treats every reported quantity as an output

questions.explanation: Residents are the input used to predict, and bus ridership is the predicted output. Reversing the pair, or calling both quantities inputs or outputs, misreads the relationship's direction.
